bund17.name: 字林西报大楼
bund17.architecture_style: 竖向窗带与双侧屋顶石塔
bund17.height_note: Model envelope, including finials; use source notes for official vs photo-proportioned dimensions.
bund17.detail_note: 逐窗核对25个中部大窗，其中24窗使用真实照片映射到原有内退玻璃，最低中央窗因浮雕遮挡保留原材质；内部框条按照片细化，重复石条合并。双塔纠正为厚实体、四根前柱、深暗开口、层叠方檐和低浅弧顶，前移山花；顶层后退窗改暗内景。约40m高度、未见侧后和细小雕饰仍有推定。

photo_texture.author: Suicasmo
photo_texture.scope: 24 individually mapped recessed glazing fronts among25 reviewed; lowest centre omitted because a carved stone plaque occludes the photograph. No photo is projected onto a whole facade plane.
